from: The game's shell on Babylon.js 9.18.0: boards: createTrailheadMeshes (trailheadMeshes.ts) under a NullEngine with the shipped models, for each board on ground of that height: the four corners of the mesh trailhead_board_face by their texture coordinates ((0, 0), (1, 0), (1, 1), (0, 1)), each carried by Vector3.TransformCoordinates through the mesh's world matrix, and (0, 0, -1) carried by Vector3.TransformNormal through it and normalised (normal). cabSky: CAB_SKY as the stage on Babylon.js names it (scene/sceneStage.ts)
